text:
Predicates:
FootballPlayer(x) ::: x is a football player.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x is born in year y.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for football club y.
Club(x) ::: x is a football club.
LoanOut(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to club y.
SameClub(x, y) ::: x is a football club along with y.
Premises:
FootballPlayer(ailtonSilva) ∧ BornIn(ailtonSilva, 1995) ∧ LoanOut(ailtonSilva, braga) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995, is commonly known as Ailton and was loaned out to Braga.
FootballPlayer(ailtonSilva) ∧ PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, nautico) ∧ PlaysFor(nautico, nautico) ∧ Club(nautico) ∧ SameClub(nautico, braga) ::: Ailton is a Brazilian footballer who plays for Nautico, and Nautico is a football club along with Braga.
Club(fluminense) ::: Fluminense is a football club.
Conclusion:
¬PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, fluminense) ::: Ailton Silva played for Fluminense.
